title: Wrist Curl
summary: A forearm curl for the wrist flexors.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: dumbbells or barbell (Olympic bar) or EZ curl bar.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for forearms (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Rest your forearms on a bench or your thighs, with your palms up and your wrists past the edge.
Let the weight roll down to your fingers.
Curl your wrists up as far as they go.

form_cues.cue: Let the bar roll to your fingers
Keep forearms flat on the support
Use high reps and a full range.

mistakes.text: Lifting the forearms to move the weight.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Similar muscles; dumbbell instead of dumbbell.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable, Steadier cable tension.
Swap sheet: More upper-trap work, Less isolation, One side at a time.
